title: Flashcards: Official languages, Africa
intro: Flip each card about Africa. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Burundi?
cards.explain: English, French, Rundi are official languages of Burundi.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Central African Republic?
cards.explain: French, Sango are official languages of Central African Republic.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Djibouti?
cards.explain: Arabic, French are official languages of Djibouti.

cards.front: Which language is official in Ethiopia?
cards.explain: Amharic is the official language of Ethiopia.

cards.front: Which language is official in Gambia?
cards.explain: English is the official language of Gambia.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Kenya?
cards.explain: English, Swahili (macrolanguage) are official languages of Kenya.

cards.front: Which language is official in Liberia?
cards.explain: English is the official language of Liberia.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Morocco?
cards.explain: Arabic, Central Atlas Tamazight are official languages of Morocco.

cards.front: Which language is official in Mauritania?
cards.explain: Arabic is the official language of Mauritania.

cards.front: Which language is official in South Sudan?
cards.explain: English is the official language of South Sudan.

cards.front: Which languages are official in United Republic of Tanzania?
cards.explain: English, Swahili (macrolanguage) are official languages of United Republic of Tanzania.

cards.front: Which languages are official in Uganda?
cards.explain: English, Swahili (macrolanguage) are official languages of Uganda.
